title: Cannot use Body (pydantic schemas)  and file upload together in an API

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI()

class EgSchemas(BaseModel):
    name: str
    age: int

@app.post("/")
async def example(create_xp: EgSchemas, file: UploadFile = File(...)):
    return {"message": "Success", "filename": file.filename, "data": create_xp}
```

answer.body:
Hello @kjathar123,

Your Pydantic model is expecting an application/json while UploadFile multipart/form-data.

Fastapi support multipart/form-data in the following way.

```python
@app.post("/")
async def example(
        file: Annotated[UploadFile, File()],
        name: Annotated[str, Form()],
        age: Annotated[int, Form()]

):
    return {"message": "Success", "filename": file.filename, "name": name, "age": age}
```
Ref to https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/request-files/
